eps.ov: While humanity celebrates, the sixth round's result rattles the gods. Brunhilde and Hermes reflect on the previous battles and humanity's resilience.
With the gods desperate for a win, Hades steps up to avenge his brother. Humanity sends Qin Shi Huang, setting the stage for a monumental clash of kings.
After uniting China, Qin Shi Huang ascends Mount Tai alone to prove himself before the demon god Chi You. There, he masters the ultimate martial art.
As a child, Qin Shi Huang's daily life is filled with hostility. Yet over time, he finds happiness in the close bond he forms with his strict caretaker.

eps.t: Pride of the King of Helheim
eps.ov: As the seventh round heats up, Hades gouges his own chest, humming as blood pours out and empowers his divine weapon with new strength.
On the brink of death, Qin Shi Huang draws strength from Alvitr, unleashing the Force of the Phoenix again. Hades readies his spear for the final blow.
For the eighth round, the gods choose Beelzebub, the god cursed by Satan. Though shunned by all, he once had three close friends who shaped his destiny.
While struggling with Beelzebub's vibration-based powers, Tesla recognizes them as a form of science and counters with the full force of human ingenuity.
Tesla traps Beelzebub in the Gematria Zone and unleashes the Tesla Step, but Beelzebub learns to nullify the onslaught. The gods expect victory, but...
Even after Beelzebub unleashes Helheim's forbidden technique, Tesla stands firm. As the battle peaks, he recalls childhood memories of his brother.
Though battered, Tesla is relentless, pushing Beelzebub on the defensive and to his limits. The showdown between science versus myth reaches its climax.

eps.t: The Sun God and the Rebellious Hero
eps.ov: The gods' next fighter is Apollo, the radiant sun god. Representing humanity is King Leonidas of Sparta. As round nine begins, neither will back down.
In the past, King Leonidas of Sparta defies Apollo's prophecies and goes to war. Now, with his pride on the line, he delivers a decisive strike at Apollo.
Fueled by unyielding resolve, Leonidas slams Apollo down. As the bloodied god rises, most gods scorn his pride, but Zeus and Ares see the truth.
Both fighters near death but stand tall, honoring each other's valor. Leonidas transforms his shield and advances as Apollo draws his mythical bow.
